findings.clinical_meaning: Infarcts in more than one arterial territory support an embolic source.
findings.name: Multiterritory cortical infarcts
findings.notes: Explicit Phase-4A vascular or epilepsy finding.

findings.clinical_meaning: Ipsilateral ptosis and miosis without anhidrosis support carotid dissection.
findings.name: Partial Horner syndrome
findings.notes: Explicit Phase-4A vascular or epilepsy finding.

findings.clinical_meaning: A carotid bruit supports turbulent flow from carotid stenosis but does not establish its severity.
findings.name: Carotid bruit
findings.notes: Explicit Phase-4A vascular or epilepsy finding.

findings.clinical_meaning: Limb dysmetria and gait ataxia support cerebellar involvement.
findings.name: Limb ataxia
findings.notes: Explicit Phase-4A vascular or epilepsy finding.

findings.clinical_meaning: Cryptogenic stroke remains after a standard vascular, cardiac, and rhythm evaluation is unrevealing.
findings.name: No identified stroke mechanism after standard evaluation
findings.notes: Explicit Phase-4A vascular or epilepsy finding.

findings.clinical_meaning: Prolonged recurrent fever-associated seizures beginning in infancy are a high-yield Dravet syndrome clue.
findings.name: Prolonged febrile seizures in infancy
findings.notes: Explicit Phase-4A vascular or epilepsy finding.

findings.clinical_meaning: A generalized convulsion with fever in the appropriate age range supports febrile seizure after CNS infection is considered.
findings.name: Fever-associated generalized convulsion
findings.notes: Explicit Phase-4A vascular or epilepsy finding.

findings.clinical_meaning: An unprovoked event is distinguished from acute symptomatic seizure by evaluation for immediate provoking causes.
findings.name: Unprovoked seizure
findings.notes: Explicit Phase-4A vascular or epilepsy finding.

findings.clinical_meaning: Preserved awareness during a stereotyped focal motor, sensory, autonomic, or psychic event supports focal aware seizure.
findings.name: Preserved awareness during focal event
findings.notes: Explicit Phase-4A vascular or epilepsy finding.

findings.clinical_meaning: An aura or unilateral focal onset before bilateral convulsions supports focal-to-bilateral tonic-clonic seizure.
findings.name: Focal onset before bilateral convulsions
findings.notes: Explicit Phase-4A vascular or epilepsy finding.

findings.clinical_meaning: Deep hemorrhage in basal ganglia, thalamus, pons, or cerebellum supports chronic hypertensive arteriopathy.
findings.name: Deep basal ganglia hemorrhage
findings.notes: Explicit Phase-4A vascular or epilepsy finding.

findings.clinical_meaning: Acute hyperdense blood within brain parenchyma establishes intracerebral hemorrhage on noncontrast CT.
findings.name: Intracerebral blood
findings.notes: Explicit Phase-4A vascular or epilepsy finding.

findings.clinical_meaning: Hyperdense blood within the ventricular system indicates intraventricular hemorrhage or extension.
findings.name: Intraventricular blood
findings.notes: Explicit Phase-4A vascular or epilepsy finding.

findings.clinical_meaning: Brief bilateral myoclonic jerks shortly after awakening support juvenile myoclonic epilepsy.
findings.name: Morning myoclonic jerks
findings.notes: Explicit Phase-4A vascular or epilepsy finding.

findings.clinical_meaning: Isolated contralateral weakness without cortical signs supports a pure motor lacunar syndrome.
findings.name: Pure motor stroke
findings.notes: Explicit Phase-4A vascular or epilepsy finding.

findings.clinical_meaning: Slow generalized spike-and-wave with multiple seizure types supports Lennox-Gastaut syndrome.
findings.name: Slow spike-and-wave
findings.notes: Explicit Phase-4A vascular or epilepsy finding.

findings.clinical_meaning: Sudden brief shock-like movements without a prolonged postictal state support myoclonic seizure.
findings.name: Brief shock-like jerks
findings.notes: Explicit Phase-4A vascular or epilepsy finding.

findings.clinical_meaning: Persistently closed eyes during a variable prolonged event favors psychogenic nonepileptic seizures over convulsive epilepsy.
findings.name: Eyes closed during event
findings.notes: Explicit Phase-4A vascular or epilepsy finding.

findings.clinical_meaning: Failure to regain baseline consciousness between seizures defines an emergency status pattern.
findings.name: Failure to recover between seizures
findings.notes: Explicit Phase-4A vascular or epilepsy finding.

findings.clinical_meaning: A resolved negative focal neurologic deficit is the defining clinical event of transient ischemic attack.
findings.name: Transient focal neurologic deficit
findings.notes: Explicit Phase-4A vascular or epilepsy finding.

findings.clinical_meaning: Stepwise loss of cognition with focal deficits supports vascular dementia.
findings.name: Stepwise cognitive decline
findings.notes: Explicit Phase-4A vascular or epilepsy finding.

findings.clinical_meaning: Occipital neck pain after minor cervical trauma supports vertebral artery dissection.
findings.name: Occipital neck pain after cervical trauma
findings.notes: Explicit Phase-4A vascular or epilepsy finding.

findings.clinical_meaning: Fragile basal collateral vessels on angiography support moyamoya disease.
findings.name: Puff-of-smoke collaterals
findings.notes: Explicit Phase-4A vascular or epilepsy finding.

findings.clinical_meaning: Behavioral arrest with impaired awareness and oral or manual automatisms supports focal impaired-awareness seizure.
findings.name: Automatisms with impaired awareness
findings.notes: Explicit Phase-4A vascular or epilepsy finding.

findings.clinical_meaning: A stereotyped déjà vu aura supports mesial temporal focal seizure onset.
findings.name: Deja vu aura
findings.notes: Explicit Phase-4A vascular or epilepsy finding.

keywords.clinical_meaning: Abrupt tearing chest or back pain is a high-risk clue for acute aortic pathology.
keywords.notes: Original board-recognition clue with explanatory context.

keywords.clinical_meaning: Granular muddy-brown casts support tubular injury in the appropriate acute kidney injury context.
keywords.notes: Original board-recognition clue with explanatory context.

keywords.clinical_meaning: Red-cell casts support glomerular bleeding rather than a lower urinary source.
keywords.notes: Original board-recognition clue with explanatory context.

keywords.clinical_meaning: Ascending weakness with areflexia localizes to an acute peripheral neuropathy pattern.
keywords.notes: Original board-recognition clue with explanatory context.

keywords.clinical_meaning: Abrupt maximal-intensity headache requires assessment for dangerous secondary causes.
keywords.notes: Original board-recognition clue with explanatory context.

keywords.clinical_meaning: Resting tremor with bradykinesia and rigidity supports a parkinsonian syndrome.
keywords.notes: Original board-recognition clue with explanatory context.

keywords.clinical_meaning: Pain out of proportion may indicate compartment physiology, ischemia, or necrotizing infection and needs urgent context-specific assessment.
keywords.notes: Original board-recognition clue with explanatory context.

keywords.clinical_meaning: Spinal ankylosis on imaging supports axial spondyloarthritis in the appropriate clinical context.
keywords.notes: Original board-recognition clue with explanatory context.

keywords.clinical_meaning: A pencil-in-cup erosive pattern is a classic imaging association of psoriatic arthritis.
keywords.notes: Original board-recognition clue with explanatory context.

keywords.clinical_meaning: A sunburst periosteal pattern raises concern for an aggressive bone-forming lesion and requires specialist-directed workup.
keywords.notes: Original board-recognition clue with explanatory context.

keywords.clinical_meaning: Layered onion-skin periosteal reaction is an imaging association of Ewing sarcoma but is not independently diagnostic.
keywords.notes: Original board-recognition clue with explanatory context.

keywords.clinical_meaning: An acutely inflamed joint requires prompt distinction of infection from crystal and inflammatory causes.
keywords.notes: Original board-recognition clue with explanatory context.

keywords.clinical_meaning: A boot-shaped cardiac silhouette is a classic association of tetralogy of Fallot.
keywords.notes: Original board-recognition clue with explanatory context.

keywords.clinical_meaning: A bounding water-hammer pulse is a classic clue for significant aortic regurgitation.
keywords.notes: Original board-recognition clue with explanatory context.

keywords.clinical_meaning: An electric sensation provoked by neck flexion can support a cervical cord process in the right context.
keywords.keyword_text: electric shock sensation with neck flexion
keywords.normalized_keyword: electric shock sensation with neck flexion
keywords.notes: Original board-recognition clue with explanatory context.

keywords.clinical_meaning: Target lesions are a pattern requiring dermatologic and infectious or medication context.
keywords.notes: Original board-recognition clue with explanatory context.

keywords.clinical_meaning: Abrupt maximal-intensity headache requires urgent evaluation for subarachnoid hemorrhage and other secondary causes.
keywords.notes: Neurology classic-clue term with explanatory educational context.

keywords.clinical_meaning: Temporal-lobe hemorrhagic injury is a classic imaging association of HSV encephalitis.
keywords.notes: Neurology classic-clue term with explanatory educational context.

keywords.clinical_meaning: High CSF protein with relatively few cells supports Guillain-Barre syndrome in the appropriate clinical timeframe.
keywords.notes: Neurology classic-clue term with explanatory educational context.

keywords.clinical_meaning: Ovoid periventricular lesions oriented along medullary veins support multiple sclerosis in the appropriate syndrome.
keywords.notes: Neurology classic-clue term with explanatory educational context.

keywords.clinical_meaning: Resting tremor with bradykinesia and rigidity supports parkinsonism.
keywords.notes: Neurology classic-clue term with explanatory educational context.

keywords.clinical_meaning: Fatigable ocular weakness supports neuromuscular-junction disease and should prompt respiratory assessment when severe.
keywords.notes: Neurology classic-clue term with explanatory educational context.

keywords.clinical_meaning: Strength that improves with repeated activation supports presynaptic neuromuscular-junction dysfunction.
keywords.notes: Neurology classic-clue term with explanatory educational context.

keywords.clinical_meaning: Dissociated cape-like pain and temperature loss localizes to a central cord process such as syringomyelia.
keywords.notes: Neurology classic-clue term with explanatory educational context.

keywords.clinical_meaning: Saddle sensory loss with sphincter symptoms is a red flag for cauda equina or conus pathology.
keywords.notes: Neurology classic-clue term with explanatory educational context.

keywords.clinical_meaning: Using the hands to rise from the floor supports proximal muscle weakness in a myopathic process.
keywords.notes: Neurology classic-clue term with explanatory educational context.

keywords.clinical_meaning: Calf enlargement with proximal weakness is a classic association of Duchenne muscular dystrophy.
keywords.notes: Neurology classic-clue term with explanatory educational context.

keywords.clinical_meaning: Cogwheel rigidity supports a parkinsonian syndrome when paired with bradykinesia.
keywords.notes: Neurology classic-clue term with explanatory educational context.

keywords.clinical_meaning: A lesion crossing the corpus callosum raises concern for glioblastoma in the appropriate imaging context.
keywords.notes: Neurology classic-clue term with explanatory educational context.

keywords.clinical_meaning: Dural attachment and enhancement are classic imaging associations of meningioma.
keywords.notes: Neurology classic-clue term with explanatory educational context.

keywords.clinical_meaning: Uniform cells with perinuclear halos are a classic histology association of oligodendroglioma.
keywords.notes: Neurology classic-clue term with explanatory educational context.

keywords.clinical_meaning: Rosenthal fibers are a characteristic histology association of pilocytic astrocytoma.
keywords.notes: Neurology classic-clue term with explanatory educational context.

keywords.clinical_meaning: Homer Wright rosettes are a neural differentiation pattern seen in medulloblastoma and other tumors.
keywords.notes: Neurology classic-clue term with explanatory educational context.

keywords.clinical_meaning: Light-near dissociation is a classic clue for neurosyphilis in the appropriate syndrome.
keywords.notes: Neurology classic-clue term with explanatory educational context.

keywords.clinical_meaning: Corneal copper deposition is a classic clue for Wilson disease.
keywords.notes: Neurology classic-clue term with explanatory educational context.

keywords.clinical_meaning: An electric sensation with neck flexion supports cervical cord involvement in the appropriate context.
keywords.notes: Neurology classic-clue term with explanatory educational context.
